integrity: The divisor product has a checked integral Stanley--Reisner polynomial certificate. The arbitrary-orientation claim follows symbolically from the torsion-free even-cell MU Atiyah--Hirzebruch spectral sequence, rational Chern--Dold map, and an identity of formal power series. Nonhomotopy is Gong--Li Theorem 4.1; no independent homotopy classification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only nonequivariant multiplicative complex-oriented generalized cohomology, compatible Chern classes, and the degree-zero complex K-theory lambda ring. No continuous map is claimed to realize the isomorphism. No assertion about unoriented, real or equivariant invariants.
title: Complex-oriented cohomology blindness of the Gong–Li toric fourfolds
